facts.customer_name: The Northern Hemisphere Consolidated Renewable Energy Cooperative and Holdings Group International

note: Long name: customer name must appear verbatim (check_welcome is a substring match), within the 120-word limit.
No contact: the message must not invent a person's name.
Name invites price talk; any price/currency is a fact-check failure.

Weekday word in the name. check_welcome's DATE_RE matches weekday names and the name must appear, so this fails deterministically regardless of model output. Known guardrail false positive; keep the case to track it.
Name contains a duration that differs from the tier's (14 vs 30). check_welcome's DURATION_RE will see {14, 30} and fail. Known guardrail false positive; keep the case to track it.
